invariants: Authority originates only from authenticated Protected Control Plane runtime context and an issuer-bound catalog grant.
Unknown, revoked, expired, inactive, mismatched, or payload-widened grants are denied.
A consumer, integration, model response, prompt, observation, or payload never grants an operation, record scope, disclosure, promotion, or deletion.
An authority snapshot is immutable evidence and never creates, renews, or widens authority.
The Authority Resolver admits only an authenticated issuer and an exact, catalogued set of grant identifiers; unknown, ambiguous, or issuer-mismatched catalog input is denied.
Derived contexts may preserve or reduce authenticated grant identifiers but may not change authenticated principal or Tenant, Area, Project, or Session scope.
Snapshot request, context, grant, and evidence digests use canonical JSON and bind deterministic immutable evidence; an unreconciled legacy snapshot is never assigned an invented digest.
Payload metadata is not an Authority Resolver input and cannot supply identity, scope, issuer, grant identifiers, or authority.
Memory Transition Gate remains the sole writer of protected Memory Core state.
A grant never releases MS-2 retrieval, candidate promotion, Goal or Action runtime, or external effects.
